WITH movie_info AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT t.id
  FROM title AS t
  JOIN movie_companies AS mc ON t.id = mc.movie_id
  WHERE mc.company_type_id = (SELECT id FROM company_type WHERE kind = 'production')
    AND t.production_year > 2005
    AND cn.country_code = '[ru]'
),
cte_cast AS (
  SELECT ci.*
  FROM cast_info AS ci
  JOIN movie_info AS mi ON mi.id = ci.movie_id
  WHERE ci.note LIKE '%(voice)%' AND ci.note LIKE '%(uncredited)%'
),
cte_char AS (
  SELECT chn.*
  FROM char_name AS chn
  JOIN cte_cast AS cc ON chn.id = cc.person_role_id
),
cte_company AS (
  SELECT mc.movie_id, cn.id, ct.id
  FROM movie_companies AS mc
  JOIN company_name AS cn ON cn.id = mc.company_id
  JOIN company_type AS ct ON ct.id = mc.company_type_id
),
cte_role AS (
  SELECT rt.id AS role_id, rt.role
  FROM role_type AS rt
)
SELECT MIN(chn.name) AS uncredited_voiced_character, MIN(t.title) AS russian_movie
FROM cte_char AS chn
JOIN cte_company AS cc ON chn.movie_id = cc.movie_id
JOIN cte_role AS rt ON rt.role = 'actor'
JOIN title AS t ON t.id = chn.movie_id

```sql
  WHERE mc.company_type_id = (SELECT id FROM company_type WHERE kind = 'production')
    AND t.production_year > 2005
    AND cn.country_code = '[ru]'
),
cte_cast AS (
  SELECT ci.*
  FROM cast_info AS ci
  JOIN movie_info AS mi ON mi.id = ci.movie_id
  WHERE ci.note LIKE '%(voice)%' AND ci.note LIKE '%(uncredited)%'
),
cte_char AS (
  SELECT chn.*
  FROM char_name AS chn
  JOIN cte_cast AS cc ON chn.id = cc.person_role_id
),
cte_company AS (
  SELECT mc.movie_id, cn.id, ct.id
  FROM movie_companies AS mc
  JOIN company_name AS cn ON cn.id = mc.company_id
  JOIN company_type AS ct ON ct.id = mc.company_type_id
),
cte_role AS (
  SELECT rt.id AS role_id, rt.role
  FROM role_type AS rt
)
SELECT MIN(chn.name) AS uncredited_voiced_character, MIN(t.title) AS russian_movie
FROM cte_char AS chn
JOIN cte_company AS cc ON chn.movie_id = cc.movie_id
JOIN cte_role AS rt ON rt.role = 'actor'
JOIN title AS t ON t.id = chn.movie_id
```

This version of the query reduces the number of subqueries and joins, which should improve its performance. It creates temporary CTEs for `movie_info`, `cte_cast`, `cte_char`, `cte_company`, and `cte_role`. Then it performs a single join between these CTEs to get the desired result. The `cte_role` is used to filter out only the rows where the role is 'actor'.
